description.zh: 查询结束时间, 单位毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region of the Data Management center for Threat Analysis. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: The assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: The assets are outside China.

description.en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the member's view.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise.
